[[Droknar's Focus]] is a unique [[focus]] obtained from the [[Elementalist's Chest]], [[Necromancer's Chest]], [[Ritualist's Chest]], [[Monk's Chest]] or [[Mesmer's Chest]] in the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 <[[attribute]]>)
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of <attribute> [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of <attribute> spells (Chance: 20%)
:''(In the case of a [[primary attribute]] version the modifiers both become 10% generic mods)''

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Kaykitt's Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Healing Prayers]] version of this item.
*[[Joffs' Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Earth Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Edielh's Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Air Magic]] version of this item.
*[[The Brainfreezer]] has stats identical to the [[Water Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Hanaku's Focus]] and [[The Mindsquall]] have stats identical to the [[Domination Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Bogroot Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Channeling Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Vokur's Chakram]] has stats nearly identical to the [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], and [[Spawning Power]] versions of this item; however, it requires [[Inspiration Magic]].
* [[The People's Resolve]] has stats nearly identical to the Divine Favor, Soul Reaping, Fast Casting, Energy Storage, and Spawning Power versions of this item; however, it has a variable requirement.
